label: Shopping
tooltip: When you have enough silver or gold, BOCCHI stops, returns to camp and lets Knightshopper buy your list. Never during a FATE or CE. Needs the Knightshopper plugin.

enable_auto_shop.label: Enable auto-shop
enable_auto_shop.tooltip: When your silver or gold reaches the amounts below, BOCCHI stops what it is doing, returns to camp and starts your Knightshopper list. It waits for a FATE, CE or Mob Farmer fight to end first. Choose what to buy in Knightshopper.

silver_threshold.label: Silver threshold
silver_threshold.tooltip: Go shopping when you have this much silver. 0 = don't shop for silver.

gold_threshold.label: Gold threshold
gold_threshold.tooltip: Go shopping when you have this much gold. 0 = don't shop for gold.
